title: Where Did My Year Go?
premise: A friend's interruption reveals an empty year. One ordinary week seems to fail until three imperfect moments make it memorable.

scenes.anchor: Mid-scroll. The off-screen command lands, Miko jolts, then asks What.
scenes.label: interruption

scenes.anchor: The friend asks. Miko starts I and stalls; a restrained reframe brings us closer.
scenes.label: question

scenes.anchor: A YEAR. One WORK jar, otherwise empty. The label carries Worked.
scenes.label: empty-year

scenes.anchor: Sad and discouraged, Miko admits all he does is work and that time is passing too fast. His phone remains held until the following decision.
scenes.label: sad-realization

scenes.anchor: He puts the phone down, releases it and looks up before the thought ends.
scenes.label: decision

scenes.anchor: A different left turn begins, with no lost outcome yet.
scenes.label: preview-route

scenes.anchor: He inspects unfamiliar soup. Stop before the taste or grimace.
scenes.label: preview-food

scenes.anchor: A tap and a raised receiver connect the call. No laughter or success yet.
scenes.label: preview-call

scenes.anchor: Sunday still arrives. The disappointed pose holds; Then I thought back motivates his turn.
scenes.label: apparent-failure

scenes.anchor: New information: he is lost, looking between the map and the wrong alley.
scenes.label: monday-lost

scenes.anchor: New information: one taste, then a brief unmistakable bad-soup grimace.
scenes.label: tuesday-soup

scenes.anchor: New information: he warms as Grandma laughs at her own joke.
scenes.label: wednesday-call

scenes.anchor: THIS WEEK: ROUTE, FOOD and CALL settle quickly, using the recollection frames.
scenes.label: week-shelf

scenes.anchor: Warm morning light and a relaxed Miko. The final sentence lands, then a 0.74s hold ends cleanly.
scenes.label: rooftop
